::: {.panel-tabset}

## Biologia

```{r}
library(plotly)
set.seed(1)
L <- runif(150, 20, 55)
W <- 0.012 * L^3.05 * exp(rnorm(150, 0, 0.08))
plot_ly(x = L, y = W, type = "scatter", mode = "markers") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Comprimento (cm)"), yaxis = list(title = "Peso (g)"),
         title = "Relação comprimento–peso (simulada)")
```

## Pescaria

```{r}
d <- subset(read.csv("../data/landings.csv"), species == "Goraz")
plot_ly(d, x = ~year, y = ~tonnes, type = "bar") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Ano"), yaxis = list(title = "Desembarques (toneladas)"))
```
